entities.summary: Strandebarm Church is a parish church of the Church of Norway in Kvam Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. It is located in the village of Strandebarm. It is the church for the Strandebarm parish which is part of the Hardanger og Voss prosti (deanery) in the Diocese of Bjørgvin. The white, wooden church was built in a long church design in 1876 using plans drawn up by the architect Ole Vangberg. The church seats about 550 people. Historically, this was the main church for the old Strandebarm Municipality.
